pages.title: About Banky Hotel & Suites
pages.body: Banky Hotel & Suites is nestled strategically along Ado-Iworoko Road, offering 28 meticulously styled residences that merge contemporary elegance with bespoke Nigerian hospitality. From corporate summits to quiet private getaways, every detail is tuned for your utmost peace.
pages.subtitle: A Sanctuary of Sophisticated Living in Ado-Ekiti
pages.meta_description: Discover Banky Hotel & Suites, Ado-Ekiti's premier boutique luxury hotel offering suites, fine dining, and peaceful hospitality.

pages.subtitle: Crafted for Rest, Rejuvenation & Executive Living
pages.title: Hotel Amenities & Services
pages.meta_description: Experience world-class amenities at Banky Hotel & Suites in Ado-Ekiti, Ekiti State.
pages.body: Enjoy uninterrupted 24/7 power supply, high-speed fiber internet, private swimming pool, 24-hour in-room dining, executive transport, and round-the-clock guarded security.

pages.subtitle: We Are Always at Your Service
pages.meta_description: Contact Banky Hotel & Suites concierge, reception, and reservation team.
pages.title: Contact & Concierge
pages.body: Located at Km 5 NDLEA Junction, Ado-Iworoko Road, Adebayo, Ado-Ekiti, Ekiti State, Nigeria. Phone: +2349035879708. Email: reservations@bankyhotelandsuites.com.

pages.title: Culinary Experiences & Bar
pages.subtitle: Gourmet Local and Continental Flavors
pages.body: Our kitchen honors Nigerian culinary heritage with signature party jollof, authentic pounded yam, and spicy catfish pepper soup alongside grilled continental favorites.
pages.meta_description: Explore the dining and cocktail menu at Banky Hotel & Suites.

faqs.question: Is airport transportation available to the hotel?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide VIP private chauffeured airport transfers from Akure Airport (AKR) straight to the hotel. You can select this add-on during booking or contact our concierge.
Reservations on our Flexible Rate can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours prior to arrival. Non-Refundable Saver rates offer a 10% discount and cannot be refunded once confirmed.
faqs.question: What is the cancellation and refund policy?
What are the standard check-in and check-out times at Banky Hotel & Suites?
faqs.answer: Standard check-in begins at 2:00 PM (14:00) and check-out is at 12:00 PM (noon). Early check-in from 10:00 AM and late checkout until 4:00 PM can be arranged upon request.
Yes! Every room and lounge table is equipped with a digital QR code menu at /qr. Simply scan or navigate to order hot food, cocktails, and amenities directly with zero phone delay.
faqs.question: Can I order food and drinks directly to my room or poolside table?

faqs.answer: We accept secure online debit/credit card payments via Paystack, direct Nigerian bank transfers, POS terminals at the front desk, and direct cash settlement upon check-in.
faqs.question: Which payment methods are accepted?

faqs.answer: Guests enjoy our private swimming pool, upscale cocktail lounge, 24-hour restaurant with in-room dining, high-speed fiber Wi-Fi, constant power backup, and guarded security.
faqs.question: What recreation facilities and amenities are available on-site?

guest_reviews.review_text: The Signature Suite is simply magnificent. The bedding is ultra plush, climate control is whisper quiet, and the slow-motion video tours matched reality perfectly. The front desk was extraordinarily warm.

I spent three nights in the Presidential Suite during an official summit in Ado-Ekiti. The staff were discreet and attentive, the catfish pepper soup was world-class, and the peaceful ambiance allowed me to rest completely. Banky Hotel is now my go-to residence in Ekiti State.
Clean, comfortable executive room with constant uninterrupted electricity and rock-solid internet for video conferences. Highly recommended for business travelers.
